data.body: C3 DESIGN CONVERGED + ACCEPTED (ADR-0021, 2026-06-04). 3-lens panel (accuracy/historical/fitness) + a convergence re-review. Outcome: my initial CI-side-signer design was REJECTED by the panel (commits to a PROTECTED base branch -> either a forbidden automated bypass identity on main or an infinite-regress where the signer's own unreviewed commit fails the next coverage walk, + an async race reintroducing the second override). CONVERGED design = KEY SEPARATION + HUMAN-HELD SIGNING KEY: (Part 1, load-bearing) ael_key_file removes the .closure-key fallback -> fail-closed (rc 1) unless DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_KEY_FILE is set; (Part 2, load-bearing) the dedicated key is held ONLY by the human bypass-actor (to sign) + CI verify-only secret (G-A); the agent NEVER holds it; signing stays inline/synchronous riding the FP-recovery PR (the human signs, not the agent) so it is covered by the same single override; (Part 3) reviewable ledger; (Part 4) audit-reconciliation DEFERRED (does not gate G-A). Invariant: ledger-honoring is reviewed-equivalent ONLY while the signing key is agent-unreachable. Convergence verdict APPROVED (all 3 criticals resolved, no new criticals). Migration moot: committed ledger has 0 data rows. NEXT: implement Part 1 (ael_key_file fail-closed + RED test + header rewrite + do-not-restore guard + FP-RECOVERY Step 5c edit) -> this is the C3 precondition that unblocks G-A.
